name: myanalyze
description: Offline-first personal finance desktop application built with Electron, React, TypeScript, Node.js, and SQLite.
author: Mikołaj Dworak

scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:backend && npm --prefix myanalyze-frontend run build:desktop && node scripts/verify-desktop-build.cjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.json
scripts.build-all: cd backend && npm install && npm run build && cd ../myanalyze-frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && npx electron-builder --win --x64 --config.directories.output="C:/myanalyze-dist"
